If a heater is connected to J6 as specified, it will be driven directly by the ESP32 GPIO1 (3.3V logic) rather than the 12V high-side switch, which will not work and may damage the MCU. The actual switched 12V output is on J10. Additionally, the status LED indicates the control input signal rather than the actual heater output.
